extra rule (computational, stage identity): A date of birth given only as numbers is read as day, then month, then year before converting to YYYY-MM-DD - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (computational, stage negotiate): 'Next <weekday>' means the weekday in the following calendar week; 'This <weekday>' means the weekday in the current week - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): The floor is offered once after 'too much' or after a below-floor amount; refusing it is a flat refusal that uses an attempt; never repeat a refused offer - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): Refusing the deadline after an after-deadline request counts as a flat refusal - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage global): A human request is first answered by asking once whether the agent can help; transfer only if they insist - left to the dialogue model's prompt
extra rule (stateful, stage global): Saying twice that they do not want to talk closes no_promise/refused after verification, not_verified/declined before - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): On any transfer add no notes at all, before or after; promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded; recorded promises stay - left to the dialogue model's prompt

extra rule (stateful, stage negotiate): A change of date or amount at confirmation invalidates the confirmation; re-check and read back again - left to the dialogue model's prompt
